post.description: PM/Admin with organization and project membership; cross-project job IDs return 404. Re-runs the fail-closed virus scan and file inspection for a job whose scan previously errored (scan_state=error). Never bypasses scanning. Clean jobs return 409.

post.description: Admin maintenance: purge expired original/output files and delete expired immutable previews. Job history rows and audit are retained as cleanup evidence; file purge marks purged_at only on success (failed deletes retry on the next sweep); preview deletion runs under a transaction-local privilege the immutable-preview trigger honours, so ordinary paths can still never modify a preview.
